list.title: Users
list.subtitle: Newest first. Click a user for their details and the account actions.
list.batchHint: A search reads users in batches; more may match further on.

actions.title: Actions
actions.suspendDescription: Payments, spending and subscription changes are refused until you lift it. Nothing is refunded.
actions.unbanDescription: The account goes back to active. A ban's refunds and forfeited bonus stay as they are.
actions.banDescription: Read-only for the days you choose. An active subscription is cancelled and the cards are blocked.
actions.banDescriptionCredits: Read-only for the days you choose. The unused paid balance ({{amount}}) goes back to the card and the bonus is forfeited. An active subscription is cancelled and the cards are blocked.
actions.warnDescription: Warnings expire after {{days}} days; the {{toBan}}th active one bans automatically. The user gets an alert and an email.
actions.removeAdminDescription: Removes the profile flag and the Cognito group: the admin site locks them out on their next request.
actions.makeAdminDescription: Adds the Cognito group "admins" and the profile flag. They sign in again on the admin site to use it.
actions.adjustDescription: A positive amount adds bonus {{unit}} (goodwill); a negative one takes {{unit}} away, bonus first. Never touches the card.
actions.refundDescription: Unused paid {{unit}} go back to the card, newest payment first (1 {{one}} = 1¢). The bonus that came with them goes too.
actions.selfNote: This is you: another admin can suspend, ban or remove your admin access.
actions.amountHint: e.g. 500 to give, -200 to take away

warnings.title: Warnings ({{active}} active of {{toBan}} to a ban)
warnings.removeDescription: It stops counting. A ban it already caused stays until you unban.

detail.logs: Their actions in the <audit>audit log</audit> (today; pick another day there).
detail.logsStripe: Their actions in the <audit>audit log</audit> and <stripe>Stripe log</stripe> (today; pick another day there).

reason.label: Reason
reason.hint: Required. Saved in the audit log with your admin id.
